Commentary.Commentary: ...THIRD INNINGS...

There is still more than 30 overs remaining. A big task for Ireland who will hope not to lose more than one wicket in this session. The English bowlers will be looking for some early wickets. Stay tuned.

All the English players contributed right from the start. Fifty for Zak Crawley and Joe Root. Ben Duckett fell for a hard-made 182 but the man of the hour was Ollie Pope who scored his maiden double-hundred. The Irish players had to toil hard. They were wayward with the ball and were punished dearly.

England have declared their innings. They lead by 352 runs! Might be just waiting for Ollie Pope to reach to his milestone and Pope has done that in some fashion, with a six. Ben Duckett might have missed out but not Ollie Pope who along with other batters have helped England get a lead over 350. Joe Root got out just after reaching to his fifty and so did Pope. However, right from the start, we saw England taking on the Irish bowlers out of the park.

OUT! STUMPED! 200 and out for Pope! Well bowled Andy McBrine! Senses that Pope will come down the track and Andy McBrine serves it way outside off. Pope swings and misses. The keeper whips the bails off quickly.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle. Ben Duckett and Ollie Pope will resume their innings. Graham Hume to begin. Here we go...

Day 1 ended as expected, total dominance from the hosts and they are well, well ahead in this game already! First it was Broad's brilliance which saw Ireland being bundled out for a low score and then the top three scored freely to bring down the deficit to just 20. England now are expected to bat for as long as possible, Day 2 is know as the best day to bat and they wuold want to cash in. Ireland will need wickets in heaps if they are to get back into the game. Can they turn it around? We will find out.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

A day totally dominated by the hosts! First, after electing to bowl, they bundled out Ireland for a low score. Broad was the star with a fifer but all the bowlers played their part. Then, their openers came out all guns blazing. They managed to score freely and both the openers aded fifties and the two added 100. Zak Crawley fell but Pope has looked solid after and he along with Ben Duckett are amidst another good stand. England just trail by another 20 and they will hope they can knock those many runs off without a wicket falling. Their aim will be to bat really long. Ireland on the other hand, will hope they can fight back on Day 2. They will need to bowl a lot tighter, their bowlers were very wayward. It will be interesting to see if they do make a comeback on Day 2. Action begins at 1530 IST (1000 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!
